module_summary: 10-state FSM using enum type: sequences through states R0-R6 with special states for overflow (OVF), drop (DRP), and mark (MRK) based on input signal.

anchors.name: cur
anchors.why: 10-state FSM register (enum ph_t): controls state machine progression and output status signals.

anchors.name: disc
anchors.why: FSM-decoded output: disconnect flag, high when state equals DRP (drop).

anchors.name: flag
anchors.why: FSM-decoded output: flag signal, high when state equals MRK (mark).

anchors.name: err
anchors.why: FSM-decoded output: error flag, high when state equals OVF (overflow).

groups.name: State machine controller
groups.description: 10-state FSM with enum-based states managing phase transitions and status outputs.

groups.name: Status outputs
groups.description: FSM-decoded status outputs indicating disconnect, mark, and error conditions.
